test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 27 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Six equal cubes, each of side 7 cm, are placed adjacent to each other. The volume of the new solid formed will be
solution:
**Given:**

Each cube side length = 7 cm

Number of cubes = 6

**Formula Used:**

Volume of a cube = side³

Total Volume = Number of cubes × Volume of one cube

**Calculation:**

Volume of one cube = 7³ cm³

Volume of one cube = 7 × 7 × 7 cm³

Volume of one cube = 343 cm³

Total Volume = 6 × 343 cm³

Total Volume = 2058 cm³

**The volume of the new solid formed is 2058 cm³.**
